title: Buck Jones, a trumpeter he admired
summary: He liked hearing Buck Jones, who played with Jack Carey several times before going north.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Just ask a minute ago about any other favorite musicians, if you remember, of the old timers on any instrument at all, if you like to hear.
Well, I did like to hear, you mean any trumpet or anything?
Anything at all, trumpet or anything else.
Well, I did like to hear Buck Jones and play too.
Well, you got to hear Buck then.
Oh yeah. Yeah, I did like to hear Buck.
Who was he with, do you remember?
Well, before Buck left New Orleans and went up north, he was playing with Jack Carey, he was, he played several times with Jack. Mm-hmm.
